updateLogZh: 游戏本体独立升级至 49.19.10，启动器版本保持 49.19.9
新手教程与正式关卡共用战斗模组，仅保留左键普攻、E技能、Space弹刀和Q大招
白日梦重现《日斩》1.0增加调查路线、旁白、贪婪证据与五种结局
修复同版本号无法触发游戏更新的问题
updateLogEn: The game is independently updated to 49.19.10 while the launcher remains on 49.19.9.
The tutorial now uses the production combat module with LMB, E, Space and Q objectives.
Daydream Reappearance: Hizan 1.0 adds investigation routes, narration, Greed evidence and five endings.
Fixed game updates not triggering when release content changed without a version bump.
